purpose: A desktop app for keeping a simple reading list of books

principles.text: Built for: me, on my laptop
Nobody signs in: everything is open to whoever has the app.
It works fully with no connection; the network is a bonus.

mustHaves.text: add a book with its title and author
acceptance: A person using the app can: add a book with its title and author
Ganger's coverage check finds the file and function that do it, in an app that builds, starts and has no placeholders left.
A person using the app can: mark a book as read
Ganger's coverage check finds the file and function that do it, in an app that builds, starts and has no placeholders left.

stack.gate: Desktop software keeps its work on the computer it runs on, so nothing needs a server.

pieces.name: desktop program (Export as a desktop app)

amendments.reason: Written from the brief and the stack decision, before any journeyman ran.
